items.headline: Is Albemarle (ALB) A Bargain Or Fully Priced On Its Investor Rights Update?
items.snippet: Most followed narrative pegs fair value ~$158.73 vs last close $90.56; P/S 1.8x vs industry 1.2x.

items.headline: Albemarle Upgrade: Can Energy Storage Recharge Lithium's Leader?
items.snippet: ALB is down over 33% in 2026 but Mizuho upgraded to Outperform ($130 PT) on BESS demand. Q3 results due Nov. 4; 16 of 26 analysts rate Buy.

items.headline: Lithium's $100 Billion Supply Gap Hands Albemarle a Domestic Moat
items.snippet: Battery storage is building a second floor of demand, and Western reshoring gives established domestic producers like Albemarle outsized leverage. In Q2 Energy Storage volumes rose 11% and realized price jumped 61% to $19.53/kg.

items.headline: Albemarle Corporation(ALB) Zacks Company Report
items.snippet: Underperform view: weaker Energy Storage volumes, falling lithium prices, Middle East related supply-chain costs ($70-90M unmitigated 2026 impact); long-term demand CAGR 10-20% 2025-2030.

items.headline: Albemarle upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Mizuho
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded ALB to Outperform, PT $130 unchanged; BESS demand tipped market balance favorable; raises 2027 Energy Storage price forecast to $21k from $17k.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered PT to $135 from $230, keeps Buy; lithium up ~67% y/y but below highs; supply/demand poised to improve into 2027.
